Post 1
📉 ASX 200 hit a new 50-day low Friday, closing at 8,665 down 37pts or 0.43%. Tech led the selloff. Five-day loss sits at 0.76%, yet the index is flat year-to-date — a market treading water, not drowning. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🔻 IT worst sector, off 1.66%. Consumer Discretionary fell 1.36%, Utilities 1.25%. Only two sectors held green: Consumer Staples +0.73% and Financials +0.27%. Defensive rotation is the clearest read from today's tape. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 3
NWL shed 8.15% to AUD 17.02, the session's heaviest loss in the ASX 200. HUB24 fell 4.33% alongside it. Wealth platform stocks bore the brunt of the tech-led selloff — two names, one clear theme. #ASX #ausbiz #wealthmanagement

Post 4
🪙 Gold sits at AUD 6,134.45/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7022. Silver at AUD 91.24/oz. Metals priced firm in local terms, yet Materials still dropped 0.84% — the softer AUD cushioned prices but didn't save the sector. #gold #silver #ASX #metals

Post 5
ASX is flat year-to-date but just set a 50-day low. Does the index hold 8,665 next week or does that level crack? Watch US tech overnight — if it steadies, local IT bounces. Drop your level below. #ASX #ausbiz #investing
